title: Lantern-Ash Ghoul
text: A thin ash-ghoul follows the warmth of your lamp, reaching more from need than malice.
flavor: It was a person once. The Reach is full of once.

defeatReward.text: You end the ghoul quietly and keep the lamp burning.

imagePrompt: A thin ash-covered revenant reaching toward a blue lantern in a ruined medical lane, tragic grimdark figure, low-tier enemy composition
